get.summary: Lists Share Subscriptions in the specified workspace.
get.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share Subscription item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [pagination](/rest/api/fabric/articles/pagination).

## Permissions

The caller must have a *viewer* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Workspace.Read.All or Workspace.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *Enable Share Subscription*, *Users can accept external data shares*, and *Enable Share Item* admin switches for the calling principal.

## Microsoft Entra supported identities

This API supports the Microsoft [identities](/rest/api/fabric/articles/identity-support) listed in this section.

| Identity | Support |
|-|-|
| User | Yes |
| [Service principal](/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals#service-principal-object) and [Managed identities](/entra/identity/managed-identities-azure-resources/overview) | Yes |

## Interface

parameters.name: recursive
parameters.description: Lists items in a folder and its nested folders, or just a folder only. True - All items in the folder and its nested folders are listed, False - Only items in the folder are listed. The default value is true.

parameters.name: rootFolderId
parameters.description: This parameter allows users to filter items based on a specific root folder. If not provided, the workspace is used as the root folder.

parameters.name: continuationToken
parameters.description: A token for retrieving the next page of results.

429.description: The service rate limit was exceeded. The server returns a `Retry-After` header indicating, in seconds, how long the client must wait before sending additional requests.

Retry-After.description: The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

default.description:
Common error codes:

* InvalidItemType - Invalid item type.

post.summary: Creates a Share Subscription in the specified workspace.
post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> Share Subscription item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

## Permissions

The caller must have a *contributor* workspace role.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *Enable Share Subscription*, *Users can accept external data shares*, and *Enable Share Item* admin switches for the calling principal.

## Limitations

- To create a Share Subscription, the workspace must be on a supported Fabric capacity. For more information, see [Microsoft Fabric license types](/fabric/enterprise/licenses#microsoft-fabric-license-types).

## Interface

202.description:
Request accepted, Share Subscription provisioning is in progress.

---
**Headers:**

**Location** `string` - The URL of the operation status, which can be used to track the operation state.

**x-ms-operation-id** `string (uuid)` - The operation ID which can be used with long running operations (LRO) APIs to track the operation state and get the result.

**Retry-After** `integer` - The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

Common error codes:

* InvalidShareInvitation - The invitation URL is missing, malformed, or not a recognized IQShare invitation link.

* ShareInvitationExpired - The invitation expired or the producer revoked the underlying share.

* ShareInvitationAlreadyConsumed - A Share Subscription was already created from the invitation.

* ItemDisplayNameAlreadyInUse - The item display name is already in use.

* WorkspaceItemsLimitExceeded - The workspace item limit was exceeded.

post.description:
> [!NOTE]
> This API is part of a Beta release and is provided for evaluation and development purposes only. It may change based on feedback and is not recommended for production use.
**When calling this API, callers must specify `true` as the value for the query parameter `beta`.**

> [!NOTE]
> Share Subscription item is currently in Preview ([learn more](/fabric/fundamentals/preview)).

Provisions the producer's shared content for the specified Share Subscription into the caller's workspace as usable Fabric items, and synchronizes the subscription to the producer's current published version. Repeating the operation is safe and synchronizes added or removed content and refreshed governance rules. On success, the Share Subscription becomes active.

This API supports [long running operations (LRO)](/rest/api/fabric/articles/long-running-operation).

## Permissions

The caller must have a *contributor* workspace role and *write* permissions for the Share Subscription.

## Required Delegated Scopes

Item.ReadWrite.All

## Required Tenant Settings

To use this API, enable the *Enable Share Subscription*, *Enable Share Item*, and *Users can accept external data shares* admin switches for the calling principal.

## Microsoft Entra supported identities

## Interface

---

**Retry-After** `integer` - The number of seconds to wait before retrying the request.

* ItemNotFound - The requested Share Subscription was not found.

* ExternalDataSharingDisabled - A required tenant setting is disabled.

* ShareSubscriptionRevoked - The producer revoked the share.

* ShareSubscriptionExpired - The share or access expired.

* InvalidShareInvitation - The bound producer reference is invalid.
